purpose: Machine-readable registry for the Texas P0 acquisition lane. Raw artifacts never live beside this registry.

sources.gate: MATPOWER and AUX bus IDs and nominal kV values must agree exactly.
Filter STATEFP=48, reproject EPSG:4269 to 4326, require exactly 254 Texas county FIPS values.
Use the official FEMA service response or the official bulk ZIP only; require 254 TX records and a non-null composite risk score.
Pin both plants and generators Parquet releases together; retain only Texas plants and candidate-relevant fields.
Keep ERCO/EPE/SWPP/MISO only; timestamps must parse as UTC and duplicate BA-hour keys are rejected.
Direct county records remain direct; zone records require the separately versioned NWS crosswalk and carry assignment_method.

sources.timestamp_evidence: Brelsford et al., Scientific Data (2024), doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03095-5, documents EAGLE-I run_start_time in UTC.
sources.gate: Annual national files are large. Omitted rows mean zero outages or a collection gap and must remain missing rather than being synthesized as zero.
Texas active installations only; bus assignment is a clearly labeled spatial proxy, never electrical connectivity.
Not acquired yet: require f00 for instantaneous weather and f01 for hourly precip/freezing-rain accumulation before promotion.
